## 更新内容 / Changes

- 优化实例创建向导：连接资源、登录方式和确认信息更清晰，并在创建前显示实际迁移范围。
- 修复从实例复制会话时的文件夹选择：会话文件夹现在默认不选，只有明确勾选的文件夹才会迁移；空选择会在创建前阻止提交。
- 复制流程在创建快照前筛选会话文件，避免先复制全部历史再删除未选内容，减少临时磁盘占用和复制时间。
- 保护 Codex 分页会话的原始字节边界，并兼容压缩的 `.jsonl.zst` 历史分段，避免创建分支时出现 `durable rollout shrank before projection`。
- 修复 Codex 普通 / Fast、页面翻译和 Ultra 状态的加载误报，并保留已运行实例的兼容状态。

- Improved the instance creation wizard with clearer connection, sign-in and confirmation steps, including the actual migration scope before creation.
- Fixed folder selection when copying sessions from an instance: folders are now opt-in, and an empty selection is rejected before creation.
- Filters selected rollout files before staging, reducing temporary disk usage and copy time instead of copying all history and deleting it later.
- Preserved byte boundaries for Codex paginated history and added compressed `.jsonl.zst` segment handling to prevent `durable rollout shrank before projection` during forks.
- Fixed false loading warnings for the Codex Normal / Fast menu, page translation and Ultra status while keeping already-running instances usable.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances run. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit before installing. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app auto-update, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures were not validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

本版本延续 Codex 桌面 / CLI、Claude Desktop 独立实例和 Claude Code CLI 支持。未完成真实付费账号端到端验收的客户端能力，不在本版本中额外宣称。

This release continues support for Codex desktop / CLI, isolated Claude Desktop instances and Claude Code CLI. Client capabilities without a completed real paid-account end-to-end check are not additionally claimed here.

## 验证来源 / Verification

来源提交、版本标签、GitHub Actions 构建记录和 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 将在发布完成后补充为本版本对应链接。已执行实例创建、按文件夹会话复制、Codex 分页会话、状态判定、类型检查和生产构建验证；真实账号登录和未实际运行的客户端形态不作为端到端验收结论。

The source commit, version tag, GitHub Actions build record and `SHA256SUMS.txt` links will be filled with this release's exact references after publication. Instance creation, folder-scoped session copying, Codex paginated history, status detection, type checking and production build verification were run. Real-account sign-in and client variants not actually run are not claimed as end-to-end acceptance.
